verdict.rationale: Digits documents automated reconciliation, transaction flagging/smart reviews, and exception surfacing as part of its AI-driven bookkeeping and 'Agentic Close' workflow, which implies reconciliation review happens, but duplicates are described as being prevented via idempotent writes rather than surfaced as a reviewable duplicate queue. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a per-bank-account reconciliation view distinguishing matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions, and any hands-on/independent confirmation of this UI.
